newsitem.title: USA: GKN Holding to acquire Southeast Research.
newsitem.headline: GKN Holding to acquire Southeast Research.

text.p: GKN Holding Corp said on Monday that it signed a definitive purchase and merger agreement to acquire all the outstanding stock of Southeast Research Partners Inc, a research and institutional brokerage boutique.
Southeast, located in Boca Raton, Florida, maintains research coverage primarily focused on small- and mid-capitalization companies located in the southeastern United States.

GKN said it was paying slightly more than $3 million in cash, stock and convertible preferred stock for Southeast Research. Southeast would contribute about $6 million in annual revenues to GKN, it said.
The acquisition, due to be completed within the month, was expected to be additive to earnings in 1997, the company said.

The firm had research coverage on companies in the technology, health care, energy, financial services, building and infrastructure, consumer and leisure and retail industry sectors, the company said.
